text:
sam: Hi all, new hire here. I can open Grafana but the "infra-summary" dashboard shows blank panels and a banner that I "need role: observability.viewer". Also Datadog shows some monitors as restricted. Who should I ping for Okta group fixes?
okta-bot: Welcome to Redwood! To get access to Grafana/Datadog/Sentry, request group membership via Okta or ping #devex.
nidhi: @sam welcome! Post your redwood email and which projects you need (eg: model-serving, infra). I usually add people to `infra-observability` and `sentry-read`.
sam: sam@redwood.com. Need dashboards for model-serving and infra-summary.
ben: Added you to `infra-observability`. Quick tip: sign out of Okta and sign back in for groups to propagate. If Grafana panels still blank, hit refresh or clear cache.
sam: signed out/in, infra dashboard now shows. Datadog still lists `gpu-queue` monitor as "no access".
ben: For Datadog some monitors are owned by other teams. I can add you as a temporary viewer or ask the owner to add the infra group. Which do you prefer?
sam: temporary viewer is fine for now. Thanks!
ben: Done, you should see it. If you need Sentry access, file a ticket to infra-accounts or request `sentry-read` in Okta.
sam: filed infra-accounts ticket with projects: model-serving, redwood-inference. Ticket #789. Thanks everyone for the speedy help!
